rules.rule: When moving from 5 Nm to 8 Nm keep FF 100 and the same VIB_FFB_STRENGTH. Every same-author source gives the same in-game value at both torques (SRS esports 80-100 at 5 and 8 Nm; SRS 70 built for 8 Nm, usable at 5; Fanatec one CSL DD/GT DD row of 80; Fanatec 2026 50-70 for every base). No source lowers in-game strength going from 5 to 8 Nm. Forces become up to 1.6x stronger; game-side clipping is unchanged if F1 25 sends a normalised command [D].
For comfort, scale VIB_FFB_STRENGTH by 5/8 (about x0.63) to keep the 5 Nm weight, then adjust by feel.

For an exact A/B against the old 5 Nm feel, set FF 63 at 8 Nm with unchanged in-game values; this reproduces the 5 Nm torque map, including its clipping. Endstop strength does not depend on FF on current firmware.

Base FW >= 1.9.0.2 raised Boost Kit holding torque from 6 to 8 Nm, so long high-load corners feel heavier than 8 Nm presets made on older firmware. If the first sessions are tiring, lower in-game strength in steps of 5-10 or use the comfort entry.
With the Boost Kit on base FW >= 1.9.0.2 FFS is not offered (Fanatec App 1.5.1.2 changelog). Set FFS PEA only if the menu still shows it (LIN gives ~6 Nm).
Presets made before v1.25 (2026-09-07) may feel lighter after it (player reports; Carson raises strength by 10-20 at 8 Nm). Start at the upper end of a published range, then adjust by feel.

Hands-off oscillation on straights: raise NDP in steps of 5 first, keep INT 1-5, then lower strength, then a little NFR; NIN with care (Fanatec oscillation guide). With NDP OFF at 8 Nm expect to need NDP 5-20 [U]. Oscillation starting at a session boundary in F1 25 v1.25+ is a known game bug, not a settings fault.
Fanatec's GT7 values are stated to suit 5 and 8 Nm. After fitting the kit restart at Max. Torque 5 (or 4-5 with A SET) and step up; post-hotfix 8 Nm reports range 5-10 with no consensus.
FUL default 100 on hotfix firmware (App >= 1.5.4.2). If FFB drops out or the base disconnects: FUL 60, then OFF; then leave 10-20% headroom (FF 80-90) and lower Sensitivity.

known_issues.title: F1 25 v1.25: the wheel oscillates or loses FFB after a session change
known_issues.detail: Since v1.25 (2026-09-07) CSL DD / GT DD Pro owners report violent left-right oscillation or lost FFB after a session change or restart (for example Qualifying to Race), until the base is power-cycled. Pause and power-cycle the base; do not tune NDP, INT or the damper against it (it happened at NDP 50 / INT 11, and FUL OFF did not help). Every report that states a torque is at 8 Nm, and no PS5 report was found. EA confirmed it and shared a fix with Fanatec on 2026-10-07 (no ETA). The rig check flags it as 'Oscillation after a session change'.
known_issues.source: EA forums threads 13695137, 13701405, 13701710; forum.fanatec.com topic 20597 (PS5 impact unverified)

known_issues.title: F1 25 v1.25: FFB reported lighter
known_issues.detail: Players on several brands report lighter or less detailed FFB after v1.25, so values from before September may feel lighter. Carson raised his 8 Nm strength by 10-20. Start at the upper end of a published range and adjust by feel.

known_issues.title: FFS (Peak/Linear) is gone with the Boost Kit on current firmware
known_issues.detail: Fanatec App 1.5.1.2 (base 1.9.0.2) removed FFS for Boost Kit bases and raised holding torque from 6 to 8 Nm. Fanatec help articles updated in September 2026 still describe LIN/PEAK, so check the Advanced menu once the kit is fitted; set PEA only if FFS is still shown.

known_issues.title: Slots may report different maximum torque
known_issues.detail: One user saw the PC App report 8 Nm in AUTO and slot 5 but 6 Nm in slots 1-4. Check what your slots report after fitting the Boost Kit.

known_issues.title: GT DD Pro can lose FFB in GT7 (wheel may spin)
known_issues.detail: Fanatec App 1.6.1.3 known issue. Not a tuning mistake. If it happens: FUL 60, then OFF; then FF 80-90 and a lower Sensitivity.

known_issues.title: SPR and DPR do not work in GT7 menus on the GT DD Pro
known_issues.detail: Fanatec App 1.6.1.3 known issue; users say they do nothing while driving.

known_issues.title: GT7 Spec IV Part 1 is reported for 2026-10-15
known_issues.detail: Headline only. Re-check GT7 values and rerun the rig check after it.

known_issues.title: FullForce weaker than intended on CSL DD / GT DD Pro
known_issues.detail: Fanatec App 1.6.1.3 known issue. No source shows that F1 25 implements FullForce: leave FUL at its default for F1.

known_issues.title: SEN AUTO misbehaves in F1 games
known_issues.detail: Fanatec App 1.6.1.3 known issue (seen on PC). Set SEN by hand to the in-game rotation.

known_issues.title: The Fanatec mobile app does not work with the new Windows App
known_issues.detail: Its own release notes say so. There is no console path for base settings on PS5 other than the on-wheel Tuning Menu.
known_issues.source: Fanatec App 1.6.1.3 release notes; App Store listing

known_issues.title: F1 25: a small FFB bump when Straight Mode switches
known_issues.detail: Reported by a DD+ owner on PS5 Pro. Not a fault; the rig check ignores it.

known_issues.title: F1 25: FFB dropping mid-race on PS5
known_issues.detail: Community reports; toggling Vibration & Force Feedback restored it.

known_issues.title: BRF reset after a restart
known_issues.detail: Fixed for the CSL DD / GT DD Pro in Fanatec App 1.4.2.3 (May 2026); 'BRF shown as 0% in the App' fixed in 1.6.1.3. Recheck BRF on the wheel after every base restart or firmware update.

known_issues.title: A firmware update resets the load cell's manual calibration and may change the base mode
known_issues.detail: After any update: DARK BLUE mode, recalibrate the wheel centre, recheck slots and BRF.
